weaknesses.title: Empty MINOBJWHERE/MAXOBJWHERE can leave last_err hard path
weaknesses.detail: No matching objects sets last_err (e.g. MAXOBJWHERE: no matching objects). Agents must COUNTWHERE gate before pick or risk soft-hard confusion. SORTBYFWHERE empty is quieter (N=0 bag).

weaknesses.title: Ties → first-seen only — no multi-winner bag
weaknesses.detail: Equal loads return single object name; cannot round-robin without extra state. SORTBYFWHERE keeps first-seen order on ties.
weaknesses.repro: two ready load=15 → cold and hot both n0

weaknesses.title: SORTBYFWHERE bag is names only — no load values paired
weaknesses.detail: Rank plate is object names; agents need GETF per name or GETFWHERE for load:value inventory.

weaknesses.title: Status equality only — no ready|idle multi-status pick
weaknesses.detail: Cannot MINOBJWHERE across ready OR idle without two picks + compare.

weaknesses.title: LAST after pick is name string; GETF LAST works only if name is live object
weaknesses.detail: Proof uses GETF LAST energy after MAXOBJWHERE; multi-run rehydrate boards usually store name then GETF by slot literal.
weaknesses.repro: GETF LAST after plate rehydrate next process
